name: merge-pick
title: Merge · pick the other listing
note: Opens full screen from the event ⋯ menu (“Merge with another listing…”). The likely duplicate (same venue and day) is offered first; search covers the rest.

name: merge-compare
title: Merge · compare
note: The two listings stack, one card each, with the same rows in the same order so you compare down the page instead of across it. Venue and day are shown once because they match.

name: merge-compare-320
title: Merge · compare at 320
note: Same board at 320. Titles and lineups wrap; row values wrap under their label width; nothing clips or scrolls sideways.

name: merge-keep-second-320
title: Merge · keep the second, at 320
note: The button names the choice. Keeping a hand-added listing says the next crawl updates it instead of adding the crawled one back.

name: merge-loading
title: Merge · loading
note: Skeleton in the compare’s final shape. The main button is a placeholder until both listings load.

name: merge-nothing-found
title: Merge · no likely duplicate
note: Empty state for the pick step. Search still works for a duplicate on another date or venue.

name: merge-merging
title: Merge · merging
note: The only spinner is inside the button while it saves.

name: merge-failed
title: Merge · couldn’t merge
note: Snaps back: both listings stay as they were and the button returns. Try again repeats the same merge.

name: run-detail-sheet
title: How you get here: a run, as a sheet
note: Tap a run on the venue’s Runs tab. The run detail opens as a sheet (rule 4), and Inspect page is its main action. Needs you items for a failing or quiet venue link to the same place.

name: inspect-read
title: Inspect · what we read
note: Phone-reachable, on purpose: a failing venue in Needs you should be checkable from a phone. “What we read” opens first, because on a phone it answers the question faster than the HTML.

name: inspect-fetched
title: Inspect · what we fetched
note: Page, Text and HTML, as on desktop. HTML wraps instead of scrolling sideways and opens at the highlight where the page stopped.

name: inspect-menu
title: Inspect · ⋯ menu
note: Desktop’s two header buttons move into the ⋯ menu. Compare opens the other run in this same view.

name: inspect-pages-gone
title: Inspect · pages no longer kept
note: Empty state: fetched pages are kept 14 days (the plan’s default retention). Counts and the reason stay on Runs.

name: inspect-couldnt-load
title: Inspect · couldn’t load
note: Error pattern: the header stays, only the content area changes.

name: start-mobile
title: Add a venue · start, mobile
note: From the + on Venues. Start from scratch sits up top; each asked-for venue is a card with its robots.txt line and the same two answers as desktop. The two source cards from desktop become one footnote.

name: start-nobody-asked-yet-mobile
title: Start · nobody asked yet, mobile
note: Empty state. Start from scratch becomes the main action.

name: start-loading-mobile
title: Start · loading, mobile
note: The title and Start from scratch are real at once; only the list is a skeleton.

name: start-couldnt-load-mobile
title: Start · couldn’t load, mobile
note: Start from scratch still works while the list is down.

name: start-not-for-us-mobile
title: Start · not for us, with Undo
note: Answered in place, like Needs you.

name: start-not-for-us-failed-mobile
title: Start · not for us didn’t save
note: The card snaps back and the toast says so.

name: going-live-mobile
title: Step 5 · going live
note: Spinner inside the button only.

name: go-live-failed-mobile
title: Step 5 · go live failed
note: Nothing is published and nobody is notified; the venue stays a draft with every step kept.

name: gone-live-mobile
title: Gone live · mobile
note: Same words as desktop. Buttons stack full width, most used first. What’s still waiting becomes a short list instead of one line.

name: source-mobile
title: Venue · Source, mobile
note: The desktop’s two columns stack in their order: How we read it, robots.txt, then the fixed rules. Advanced stays collapsed at the bottom of the first card. No Save bar until something changes.

name: source-mobile-320
title: Venue · Source, at 320
note: Tabs scroll sideways (as on every venue tab). Values wrap under their labels.

name: source-feed-edited
title: Source · switched to a ticketing feed
note: Picking a feed shows its two fields. A pinned Save bar appears with the change named; Test it now runs first.

name: source-test-running
title: Source · test running
note: Each check ticks off as it happens; a test never publishes.

name: source-advanced-open
title: Source · Advanced open
note: Three settings from today’s venue (page loading, wait until, wait for) and the debug toggle.

name: source-robots-disallows
title: Source · robots.txt disallows
note: The robots card turns warning, crawling reads “Paused: robots.txt”, and Ask the venue is the way forward. We never override it.

name: source-dont-crawl
title: Source · don’t crawl
note: The nearest thing to empty: no calendar, no robots check, no fixed rules to show.

name: source-loading
title: Source · loading
note: The venue header is already loaded from the tab you came from; the tab’s cards are skeletons.

name: source-save-failed
title: Source · save failed
note: Snaps back to what is saved (the calendar page) and says so.
